ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure is a group of line drawings of the dehiscence methods of plant fruits or capsules, respectively labeled with letters. The letter I is located at the lower row, slightly to the right; the figure corresponding to it shows a capsule-like structure, with the top or side split open into several longitudinal valves, the fissures opening along the length direction, as if splitting between the separate parts, rather than opening through a pore, lid, or single suture. Then reason: the question asks what type label I belongs to. In botany, the dehiscence method in which a capsule splits longitudinally along the septa or partitions between carpels is called septicidal dehiscence. Therefore label I is Septicidal.
